stanza.line: O Lamb of God, was ever pain,
Was ever love like thine?

division.rawSourceFragment: <verse id="v.vi-p32.1"> <l id="v.vi-p32.2">O Lamb of God, was ever pain,</l> <l id="v.vi-p32.3">Was ever love like thine?</l> </verse>

poem.title: A PARAPHRASE ON THE LORD’S PRAYER

stanza.line: 1 Father of all, whose powerful voice
Call’d forth this universal frame;
Whose mercies over all rejoice,
Through endless ages still the same.
Thou, by thy word, upholdest all;
Thy bounteous love to all is show’d,
Thou hear’st thy every creature’s call,
And fillest every mouth with good.

division.rawSourceFragment: <verse id="v.xxvi-p48.1"> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.2">1 Father of all, whose powerful voice</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.3">Call’d forth this universal frame;</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.4">Whose mercies over all rejoice,</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.5">Through endless ages still the same.</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.6">Thou, by thy word, upholdest all;</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.7">Thy bounteous love to all is show’d,</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.8">Thou hear’st thy every creature’s call,</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.9">And fillest every mouth with good.</l> </verse>

stanza.line: 2 In heaven thou reign’st, enthroned in light,
Nature’s expanse beneath thee spread;
Earth, air, and sea before thy sight,
And hell’s deep gloom are open laid.
Wisdom, and might, and love are thine:
Prostrate before thy face we fall,
Confess thine attributes divine,
An hail the Sovereign Lord of All.

stanza.line: 3 Thee, sovereign Lord, let all confess
That moves in earth, or air, or sky
Revere thy power, thy goodness bless,
Tremble before thy piercing eye.
All ye who owe to Him your birth,
In praise your every hour employ:
Jehovah reigns! Be glad, O earth!
And shout, ye morning stars, for joy!

Be glad, O earth!</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.27">And shout, ye morning stars, for joy!</l> </verse>

stanza.line: 4 Son of thy Sire’s eternal love,
Take to thyself thy mighty power;
Let all earth’s sons thy mercy prove,
Let all thy bleeding grace adore.
The triumphs of thy love display;
In every heart reign thou alone;
Till all thy foes confess thy sway,
And glory ends what grace begun.

stanza.line: 5 Spirit of grace, and health, and power,
Fountain of light and love below,
Abroad thine healing influence shower,
O’er all the nations let it flow.
Inflame our hearts with perfect love;
In us the work of faith fulfil;
So not heaven’s hosts shall swifter move
Than we on earth to do thy will.

stanza.line: 6 Father, ‘tis thine each day to yield
Thy children’s wants a fresh supply:
Thou cloth’st the lilies of the field,
And hearest the young ravens cry.
On thee we cast our care; we live
Through thee, who know’st our every need;
O feed us with thy grace, and give
Our souls this day the living bread!

division.rawSourceFragment: <verse id="v.xxvi-p48.46"> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.47">6 Father, ‘tis thine each day to yield</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.48">Thy children’s wants a fresh supply:</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.49">Thou cloth’st the lilies of the field,</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.50">And hearest the young ravens cry.</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.51">On thee we cast our care; we live</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.52">Through thee, who know’st our every need;</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.53">O feed us with thy grace, and give</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.54">Our souls this day the living bread!</l> </verse>

stanza.line: 7 Eternal, spotless Lamb of God,
Before the world’s foundation slain,
Sprinkle us ever with thy blood;
O cleanse and keep us ever clean.
To every soul (all praise to Thee!)
Our bowels of compassion more:
And all mankind by this may see
God is in us; for God is love.

division.rawSourceFragment: <verse id="v.xxvi-p48.55"> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.56">7 Eternal, spotless Lamb of God,</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.57">Before the world’s foundation slain,</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.58">Sprinkle us ever with thy blood;</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.59">O cleanse and keep us ever clean.</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.60">To every soul (all praise to Thee!)</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.61">Our bowels of compassion more:</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.62">And all mankind by this may see</l> <l id="v.xxvi-p48.63">God is in us; for God is love.</l> </verse>

stanza.line: 8 Giver and Lord of life, whose power
And guardian care for all are free;
To thee, in fierce temptation’s hour,
From sin and Satan let us flee.
Thine, Lord, we are, and ours thou art;
In us be all thy goodness show’d;
Renew, enlarge, and fill our heart
With peace, and joy, and heaven, and God.

stanza.line: 9 Blessing and honour, praise and love,
Co-equal, co-eternal Three,
In earth below, in heaven above,
By all thy works be paid to thee.
Thrice Holy! thine the kingdom is,
The power omnipotent is thine;
And when created nature dies,
Thy never-ceasing glories shine.
